bookTitle: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis

facts.topic: Wyckoff's Third Law in Single Candles
facts.statement: Single-candle analysis in VPA is governed by Wyckoff's Third Law of Effort versus Result, where trading volume represents market effort and candlestick price spread represents the resulting price progression.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: This single-candle analysis is governed by Wyckoff’s Third Law: Effort vs. Result. Effort is represented by Trading Volume... Result is represented by Price Spread.

facts.statement: A wide spread candle accompanied by well above-average volume is validated as a genuine move supported by major operators, reflecting strong bullish or bearish market sentiment.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: A wide-bodied candlestick accompanied by well above-average volume... This confirms that the price move is genuine and backed by insiders/market makers.

facts.statement: A narrow spread candle accompanied by low volume is validated as a true, unmanipulated picture of low market activity where small price changes require only minimal effort.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: A narrow-bodied candlestick accompanied by well below-average volume... A small price change requires only a small amount of effort. This represents a true, unmanipulated picture of low market activity.

facts.statement: A wide spread candle paired with low volume represents an anomaly and a trap set by market makers who mark prices up or down without genuine buying orsten support.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: A wide-bodied candlestick accompanied by below-average or low volume... Indicates a fake move or trap set by market makers... price is being marked up (or down) without genuine buying or selling pressure.

facts.statement: On 1-minute charts during equity market openings, market makers push prices higher on low volume to test retail buying interest; if volume confirms no participation, prices are quickly marked back down.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The market opens, then the price is pushed higher to test interest in the market from the buyers. If there is little or no buying interest, as here, then the price will be marked back down.

facts.statement: During fundamental forex news releases, market makers exploit low volume by pushing prices vertically to trigger retail stop-loss orders before reversing the market against trapped traders.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: A fundamental item of news is released, and the market makers see an opportunity to take stops out of the market. The price jumps on the news, but the associated volume is low.

facts.statement: A narrow spread candle paired with high or ultra-high volume indicates massive effort generating minimal price progression, signaling market absorption, weakness at tops, or strength at bottoms.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: A narrow-bodied candlestick accompanied by high or ultra-high volume... Represents a massive amount of effort generating minimal price progression. Signals market weakness at trend tops... or strength at trend bottoms.

facts.statement: High volume on a narrow spread at market tops represents an intense battle where insider selling absorbs retail buying demand, capping price progress and warning of an impending reversal.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: High volume with narrow spread shows an intense battle where retail buyers are trying to push prices higher, but every wave of buying is met with insiders selling inventory... Insider supply absorbs retail demand.

facts.statement: High volume on a narrow spread at market bottoms indicates that insider buying is successfully absorbing retail panic selling, preventing prices from falling further and signaling a reversal point.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: High volume on a narrow spread indicates insider buying is absorbing retail panic selling, preventing prices from dropping further... and once again signals a potential reversal point.

facts.statement: Market makers operate like wholesale merchants clearing out inventory from their warehouse at retail prices near market tops before pushing prices down to restock at wholesale levels.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Market makers operate like wholesale merchants clearing out inventory from their warehouse at retail prices near market tops before pushing prices down to restock at wholesale levels.

generalAssumptions: Market price manipulation is structurally transparent on the volume tape.
Effort versus result governs institutional capital movement.
